label: 0. Register Map
info: Tabel register Modbus TCP untuk pembacaan (READ) dan penulisan (WRITE). Edit function node '📋 Register Map' untuk menambah/mengubah register.

label: 1. Modbus Poller (Read)
info: Polling perangkat Modbus TCP menggunakan modbus-flex-getter dan decoding sesuai tabel Register Map.

label: 2. Modbus Control (Write)
info: Menerima perintah write dari backend/dashboard dan menulis ke coil/register perangkat fisik via modbus-flex-writer.

label: 3. 3-Phase Simulator
info: Simulator 28 parameter listrik realistis. Aktif jika ENERGY_SOURCE_MODE=simulation.

label: 4. Backend Sender
info: Mengirim batch telemetry ke backend HTTP endpoint /api/internal/telemetry.

name: 📋 Register Map (READ & WRITE)
func:
/**
 * ==========================================================================
 * TABEL REGISTER MAP MODBUS TCP
 * ==========================================================================
 * Panduan Penambahan Register:
 * 
 * 1. Bagian READ (Pemantauan):
 *    - meter: 'kwh-besar' atau 'kwh-kecil'
 *    - unitId: Modbus Slave / Unit ID (default: 1 untuk BESAR, 2 untuk KECIL)
 *    - key: parameter (voltageR, voltageS, voltageT, currentR, currentS, currentT,
 *           wattR, wattS, wattT, kwhR, kwhS, kwhT, totalWatt, totalKwh)
 *    - fc: Function Code (3 = Read Holding Registers, 4 = Read Input Registers)
 *    - address: Alamat register awal (0-based atau sesuai manual meter).
 *               Jika masih null, meter belum akan dibaca (tidak ada data palsu).
 *    - type: 'float32' | 'uint32' | 'int32' | 'uint16' | 'int16'
 *    - wordSwap: true jika word urutan CDAB (little-endian word order)
 *    - scale: Faktor pengali nilai engineering (contoh: 0.1 jika meter kirim 2200 = 220V)
 * 
 * 2. Bagian WRITE (Kontrol Dua Arah):
 *    - tag: ID unik kontrol (contoh: 'relay-1', 'power-limit')
 *    - label: Nama tampilan yang muncul di menu Dashboard Control
 *    - unitId: Modbus Slave ID
 *    - fc: 5 = Write Single Coil, 6 = Write Single Register, 16 = Write Multi Registers
 *    - address: Alamat register/coil tujuan
 *    - type: 'bool' (ON/OFF switch) | 'uint16' | 'int16' | 'float32'
 *    - scale, min, max, unit: Opsi untuk kontrol numerik
 * ==========================================================================
 */

const READ = [
  // --- KWH BESAR (Meter 1, Unit ID 1) ---
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'voltageR', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'voltageS', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'voltageT', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'currentR', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'currentS', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'currentT', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'wattR',    fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'wattS',    fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'wattT',    fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'kwhR',     fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'kwhS',     fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'kwhT',     fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'totalWatt',fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, key: 'totalKwh', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },

  // --- KWH KECIL (Meter 2, Unit ID 2) ---
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'voltageR', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'voltageS', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'voltageT', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'currentR', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'currentS', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'currentT', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'wattR',    fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'wattS',    fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'wattT',    fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'kwhR',     fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'kwhS',     fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'kwhT',     fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'totalWatt',fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 },
  { meter: 'kwh-kecil', unitId: 2, key: 'totalKwh', fc: 3, address: null, type: 'float32', wordSwap: false, scale: 1.0 }
];

const WRITE = [
  { tag: 'lamp-1', label: 'Lamp 1', meterId: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, fc: 5, address: 10, type: 'bool', description: 'Lamp 1 lighting circuit (Coil 10)' },
  { tag: 'lamp-2', label: 'Lamp 2', meterId: 'kwh-besar', unitId: 1, fc: 5, address: 11, type: 'bool', description: 'Lamp 2 lighting circuit (Coil 11)' }
];

global.set('modbusMap', { READ, WRITE });

const configuredCount = READ.filter(r => r.address !== null).length;
node.status({ fill: configuredCount > 0 ? 'green' : 'yellow', shape: 'dot', text: 'Map loaded: ' + configuredCount + '/28 read registers set, ' + WRITE.length + ' write points' });
return null;
